message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout and I realized just how much I take electricity for granted! After gathering up some flashlights and a power bank for my phone, I decided to make the most of it. We dug out some board games I hadn't touched in ages and spent the evening laughing and reconnecting without screens. It was such a delightful reminder that low-tech fun can still be the best kind. Have you had any fun blackout moments lately?
